author: mmusich
body: #### PR description: The goal of this PR is two-fold: - add 1D comparison plots of ECAL laser corrections (`EcalLaserAPDPNRatios`), both 1 IoV in 2 different tags and 2 IoVs in the same tag - fix the wrong multiplicity used in the OneTag classes #### PR validation: Run the following script: ```bash #!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail RUN=398802 LUMIS=(3 125 246 366 485 605 724 842) # sorted by LS OUT=plots rm -rf "$OUT"; mkdir -p "$OUT" # avoid stale PNGs from earlier runs for ls in "${LUMIS[@]}"; do iov=$(( (RUN << 32) | ls )) # packed run/LS IoV name=$(printf "LS_%04d" "$ls") getPayloadData.py \ --plugin pluginEcalLaserAPDPNRatios_PayloadInspector \ --plot plot_EcalLaserAPDPNRatiosHistCompareTwoTags \ --tag EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_prompt_v3_inRunLSIoVs \ --input_params "{}" \ --tagtwo EcalLaserAPDPNRatios_weekly_hlt \ --time_type Run \ --iovs "{\"start_iov\": \"${iov}\", \"end_iov\": \"${iov}\"}" \ --iovstwo '{"start_iov": "398785", "end_iov": "398785"}' \ --db Prod --test mv *.png $OUT/$name.png done # explicit numeric LS ordering for the GIF convert -delay 100 -loop 0 $(ls $OUT/LS_*.png | sort -V) apdpn_ratios_compare.gif ``` and obtained the plot here: #### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for: N/A Cc: @sakura-ngt
title: add 1D comparison plots of ECAL laser corrections
